app_supportChatWelcome: Hello! 👋 I'm the BMF Concierge, your personal BookmarkForge support assistant. Ask me anything about the app — features, troubleshooting, privacy, AI setup, and more. I'm here to help!
app_supportChatHi: Hi there! 👋 How can I help you with BookmarkForge today? You can ask me about features, privacy, AI setup, troubleshooting, or anything else.
app_supportChatDefault: I'm not sure I understand. Could you rephrase your question? You can ask about privacy, backups, AI setup, shortcuts, import/export, or describe a problem you're having.
app_supportChatPrivacy: 🔒 **Privacy & Security** — BookmarkForge is 100% local-first. Your data lives in your browser's IndexedDB, never on our servers. We have no access to your bookmarks, notes, or AI prompts. Encryption is AES-256-GCM with keys derived locally from your master password. Zero telemetry, zero tracking, GDPR-compliant by design.
app_supportChatEditor: 📝 **Block Editor** — Use `/` to access slash commands: `/h1`, `/h2`, `/bullet`, `/todo`, `/code`, `/image`, `/quote`, `/columns-2`, `/columns-3`, `/divider`, `/callout`, `/toggle`. Supports drag-and-drop, LaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, and code highlighting for 50+ languages. The AI Copilot can help you write, summarize, and improve text in real-time.
app_supportChatBookmarks: 🔖 **Bookmarks** — Save any web page with one click using the extension or bookmarklet. The virtualized list handles 100,000+ items smoothly. Use tags to organize, Smart Collections for auto-grouping, and Deep Search to find content inside saved pages. Press `Ctrl+Shift+V` for Quick Capture.
app_supportChatRAG: 🤖 **Local RAG Chat** — The AI reads your documents and bookmarks before answering, giving you personalized responses based on YOUR knowledge. Choose between private mode (local AI only, zero data leaves your device) or web search mode (combines your library with live internet results).
app_supportChatTheme: 🎨 **Themes & Appearance** — Go to Settings → Appearance to switch between Light, Dark, and System themes. You can also change the font family (Sans-serif, Serif, Monospace) and adjust the base font size and line height for comfortable reading.
app_supportChatTutorials: 📚 **Getting Started** — 1. Set your master password. 2. Drag the 'Save to Forge' bookmarklet to your bookmarks bar. 3. Create your first note using `/`. 4. Explore the Dashboard, Bookmarks, and AI Chat. 5. Make a .bmf backup! Check the FAQ tab for detailed answers.
app_supportChatShortcuts: ⌨️ **Keyboard Shortcuts** — `Ctrl+K`: Omnibar (global search). `Ctrl+Shift+V`: Quick Capture. `Ctrl+Shift+P`: Command Palette. `Ctrl+B`: Toggle Sidebar. `/` in editor: Slash command menu. See all shortcuts in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts.
app_supportChatBackup: 💾 **Backup & Export** — Create .bmf backups regularly from Settings → Storage. You can export your data as Markdown, CSV, JSON, or PDF. To restore, go to Settings → Import and select your .bmf file. We recommend exporting before major updates and keeping copies on external drives.
app_supportChatAiSetup: 🧠 **AI Setup** — Go to Settings → AI to configure your provider. Cloud options: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter. Local options: Ollama (run on your machine) or WebLLM (runs in your browser via WebGPU). For free local AI, install Ollama and select it as your provider.
app_supportChatTroubleshoot: 🔧 **Troubleshooting** — First, try refreshing the page (F5). If that doesn't help: 1. Run System Diagnostics in the Diagnostics tab. 2. Clear your browser cache. 3. Check if your disk is full. 4. Restore from a recent .bmf backup. 5. Check your browser supports WebGPU and IndexedDB. Most issues are resolved by refreshing or restoring a backup.
app_supportChatSync: 🔄 **P2P Sync** — BookmarkForge uses WebRTC for peer-to-peer synchronization. Both devices must be on the same network (or use a signaling server). Go to Settings → Cloud Sync to configure. Sync is zero-knowledge: data is encrypted before transmission and only decrypted on your devices.
app_supportChatMigration: 📥 **Import & Migration** — You can import from Notion, Evernote, Obsidian, or standard browser bookmarks. Go to Settings → Import and select your HTML, JSON, or CSV export file. Your imported data is encrypted locally just like everything else.
app_supportChatVault: 🔐 **Vault & Passwords** — Your vault is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your master password. There is NO 'forgot password' option — your password is the only key. Always save your recovery phrase in a safe place and keep regular .bmf backups. Minimum 12 characters; we recommend a strong passphrase.
app_supportChatCanvas: 🎨 **Canvas** — The canvas is an infinite whiteboard for visual thinking. Create cards, connect them with lines, add images, and organize ideas spatially. Perfect for brainstorming, mind maps, project planning, and visual note-taking.
app_supportChatDatabase: 🗄️ **Database View** — A spreadsheet-like view of all your documents with sortable columns, filters, and bulk actions. You can view, edit, and manage your data in a familiar table format. Use the filter bar to narrow down by tags, dates, or content type.
app_supportChatKanban: 📋 **Kanban Board** — Organize your tasks and projects with a drag-and-drop Kanban board. Create columns for different stages (Todo, In Progress, Done) and move cards between them. Each card links to a full document for detailed notes.
app_supportChatMobile: 📱 **Mobile & PWA** — Install BookmarkForge as a Progressive Web App on your phone or tablet. On Android (Chrome): tap the 'Install app' banner. On iOS (Safari): tap Share → Add to Home Screen. Full offline support — all features work without internet.
app_supportChatLicense: 💎 **License & Pro Features** — The core app is free forever. Pro unlocks P2P sync across 5 devices, unlimited local AI. It's a one-time payment of $79 — no subscription. Go to Settings → Pro to activate your license key.
app_supportChatFlashcards: 🃏 **Flashcards & Spaced Repetition** — Generate flashcards from any document with one click. BookmarkForge uses a modified Anki-style algorithm (SRK) that tracks your forgetting curve and schedules reviews at the optimal time. Great for studying, memorizing notes, and language learning.
app_supportChatGraph: 🕸️ **Knowledge Graph** — The Graph View visualizes connections between your notes and bookmarks. Nodes are your content; edges represent tags, links, and semantic similarity. Filter by tags, date range, or connection strength. Zoom and pan to explore your knowledge network.
app_supportChatVoice: 🎙️ **Voice Commands** — Use voice to control BookmarkForge hands-free. Say 'Hey BMF, find my notes on Biology' or 'Bookmark this page'. Works 100% offline via the Web Speech API. Enable in Settings and use `Ctrl+Shift+V` to start voice dictation for notes.
app_supportChatSearch: 🔍 **Search & Omnibar** — Press `Ctrl+K` to open the Omnibar — your universal command center. Search across all bookmarks and documents, perform math calculations, convert units, and execute system commands. Type `>` for system actions or `?` to ask the AI directly.
app_supportChatCollaboration: 🤝 **Collaboration** — Share collections with team members via encrypted P2P links. Generate a share link from the sidebar, send it to your collaborator, and both can view and edit in real-time. No central server — data flows directly between devices with end-to-end encryption.
app_supportChatOffline: 📡 **Offline Mode** — BookmarkForge works 100% offline. All features — editor, bookmarks, graph, local AI (with Ollama), search, and flashcards — function without internet. Cloud AI features (Gemini, OpenAI) and web search require connectivity, but everything else works perfectly offline.
app_supportChatStorage: 💿 **Storage & Space** — Your data is stored in your browser's IndexedDB. Check your usage in Settings → Storage. If you're running low on space, you can compact the database, clear the AI cache, or export and archive old data. The app can handle 100,000+ items before needing cleanup.
app_noFlashcardsHint: Generate flashcards from any document using the AI Copilot. Open a document and click 'Generate Flashcards' to get started.
app_graphEmptyDesc: Add bookmarks and documents to see connections between your ideas. The graph visualizes tags, links, and semantic similarity.

app_p2pLanWarningTitle: Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network
app_p2pLanWarningBody: This sync works device-to-device over your local network, never through the internet. If the devices are on different networks (for example, one on mobile data), pairing and syncing will fail.
app_p2pLanWarningHint: Tip: turn off mobile data on your phone and connect it to the same Wi-Fi as your computer.

consent_description: BookmarkForge is privacy-first: all data stays on your device. We need your consent for optional diagnostic features that help us improve the app.
consent_analytics_desc: Help us understand how the app is used
consent_errorReporting_desc: Report crashes and errors to help us fix issues
privacy_s1_text: BookmarkForge ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your data when you use our application.
privacy_keyPrincipleText: BookmarkForge runs 100% locally on your device. Your bookmarks, notes, documents, and AI conversations are stored in your browser's local database and are never transmitted to our servers.
privacy_s2_intro: We want to be clear about what we do not collect:
privacy_s2_b1: No bookmarks or URLs are sent to our servers
privacy_s2_b2: No notes or documents leave your device
privacy_s2_b3: No AI prompts or responses are logged by us
privacy_s2_b5: No personal information is required to use the app
privacy_s2_b6: No analytics are collected by default
privacy_s3_intro: All your data is stored locally in your browser using:
privacy_s3_closing: Your data never leaves your device unless you explicitly export a backup, share your vault, or use a cloud AI provider.
privacy_s4_b3: Keys are derived and stored locally in your browser
privacy_s4_closing: We do not have access to your encryption keys or passwords.
privacy_s5_b1: Runs entirely in your browser. No data leaves your device.
privacy_s5_b2: Your prompts are sent directly to the provider. We do not intercept, store, or log these requests.
privacy_s6_b1: Download all your data as an encrypted backup at any time
privacy_s6_b2: Remove all data from the app settings
privacy_s6_b3: We don't have accounts, so there's nothing to delete on our end
